semantics.binding_rule: Matched Trigger references an exact Routine or runner-creation operation.
semantics.dispatch_rule: Trigger activation requests execution through the governed dispatcher/runner boundary.
semantics.authority_rule: Trigger binding carries explicit execution authority/policy context; Event content itself grants none.
semantics.loop_rule: Event→Trigger→Runner→Event cycles are detectable and bounded according to recursion/loop policy.

invariants.rule: Routine definitions and runner executions are separate canonical identities; runners execute explicit ordered routine content through the normal governed dispatch boundary.
